directAnswer.en: This is a site without a stable grid for a pump motor. The printed slump is 180–220 mm, with aggregate 1–3 cm. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists Tractor-Driven 4100 at 40 kW, 6–12 m³/h, 15 MPa, 40–100 m horizontal / 15–45 m vertical, aggregate 1–3 cm, hopper 0.25 m³, slump 180–220 mm, 2900 × 1000 × 1350 mm and 1300 kg. The machine is tractor-driven. Do not move the same condition onto Rural Self-Built House Diesel Pump, which prints diesel 17 kW, 5–8 m³/h, 15 MPa, horizontal 30–50 m, vertical 10–30 m, aggregate 1–3 cm, hopper 0.2 m³, 2200 × 1100 × 1250 mm and 800 kg. The photograph is a working-condition reference from a public article about this kind of work. It is not a Pinjin contract record. This page names no project, no country job, no price and no daily volume.

body.en: Send the mix, the largest stone, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical line you measured, and confirm the site cannot feed the matching electric motor. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job, a price or a daily volume.
body.zh: 请发送配合比、最大石子、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，并确认现场供不上对应的电动电机。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上项目名称、国家工程、价格或日方量。
